name: Verdant Resilience Cloak
modifier_sentence: This item grants a +1 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws.

features.Verdant Resilience: While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.
features.Nature's Bond: Once per day, you can use an action to cast Pass Without Trace without expending a spell slot. This property recharges at dawn.

physical_description: A flowing cloak woven from living vines that shimmer with emerald luminescence. Thorny patterns spiral along the hem, and the fabric pulses gently with a heartbeat-like rhythm.
lore: Cultivated by the druids of the Moonwood Circle over three generations, this cloak was shaped from a single ancient vine that once sheltered a dying fey lord. Now it seeks a guardian who will shield the balance between civilization and wilderness.

related_npcs.name: Lyralei of the Moonwood
related_npcs.context: The master druid who spent decades cultivating the cloak from living vine.
related_npcs.source_quote: cultivated by the druids of the Moonwood Circle over three generations
